rule_under_test: Artifact-producing workflows cannot expose success, download, share, delivery or paid-pilot claims until the generated artifact passes deterministic non-empty/useful-size gates and records post-gate proof metadata.
source_operational_rule: website/video-studio.js::minimumUsefulVideoBytes + renderVideo non-empty gate + recordRenderProof after gate

accepted_learning_proof_filter.accepted: A versioned workflow/code rule or operational gate changed and has regression checks tied to the changed path.
rejected: creating task-board entries without an executed workflow change
counting UI success text as proof without artifact bytes/playback/download evidence

regression_cases.input_condition: MediaRecorder stops with zero dataavailable chunks
chunks exist but blob.size is below max(160000, durationSeconds * 45000)
must_hold: fileInfo includes chunk count, blob bytes and minimum bytes
no success path or paid-pilot claim is unlocked

regression_cases.input_condition: chunks exist and blob.size is above the duration-aware threshold
must_hold: localStorage studioVideoLastRenderProof is written only after the gate
proof includes bytes, durationSeconds, mimeType, dimensions, mediaCount and userAgent
regression_cases.code_anchor: recordRenderProof(duration, blob, hadAudio) after non-empty gate

promotion_rule: The Revenue Operations Agent remains blocked until real Android Chrome evidence proves photos load, preview renders, non-empty WEBM generates, downloaded file plays, and localStorage proof matches the downloaded file.
fallback_if_device_qa_blocked: Do not wait. Keep revenue blocked, keep the deterministic gate promoted, and execute the next smallest workflow hardening task with regression coverage.
next_executable_learning_task: Create or run an Android Chrome QA proof file with downloaded WEBM size, playback result and localStorage studioVideoLastRenderProof payload; if pass, update the product gate and launch only a narrow 19 EUR paid-offer test.
